subTitle: Common questions about Changia and how the platform works.

faqs.question: What is Changia?
faqs.answer: Changia is a Tanzania-first fundraising organization — not just a money collection platform. It helps organizations, families and community groups raise the support they need, from mobile-money contributions to donated items and in-kind help. Money collection is one powerful feature within a platform built around the idea of contributing to a cause.

faqs.question: Do you collect only money, or also things?
faqs.answer: Both. Changia is a fundraising organization that collects money and coordinates donated items — food, clothes, books, medicine, equipment and more — on the same campaign. Organizers can list the items they need, and contributors can support in cash or in kind.

faqs.question: How do donors pay?
faqs.answer: Donors open the Campaign  link, choose an amount, and pay through their mobile-money gateway (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, HaloPesa). The PIN is entered only in the secure gateway prompt — Changia never sees or stores it.

faqs.question: What is a Push Donation?
faqs.answer: For face-to-face fundraising: a Campaign  manager gets a supporter's agreement, enters their phone number and the amount, and sends a payment request. The donor just confirms with their own PIN in their mobile-money app.

faqs.question: How does the service fee work?
faqs.answer: Changia adds its service fee on top of your Campaign  goal — not out of your donors' contributions. For example, a TZS 10,000,000 Campaign  with a 5% fee has a public target of TZS 10,500,000. Reach it, and you keep the full 10,000,000 — donors gave the rest to cover platform costs, transparently.

faqs.question: Is my donation confirmed immediately?
faqs.answer: Every donation is confirmed only after a verified payment callback from the mobile-money gateway. Payment attempts use unique idempotency keys so the same gateway event is never counted twice.

faqs.question: Can I track donors and send updates?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Donor Pool (CRM) lets you track supporters, their consent status, and giving history — in cash or in kind. Every donor gets an instant receipt and a progress update after they give.
